context:
Implement in bounded phases with tests after each phase.

1) Fix benchmark name normalization in benchbox/base.py so fallback strips
trailing 'Benchmark' and preserves special mappings.

2) Add databases-path helper in benchbox/utils/path_utils.py and route DB
artifact path creation in config/utils and adapters (DuckDB/SQLite/DataFusion)
to benchmark_runs/databases, keeping datagen data paths unchanged.

3) Add regeneration-time stale artifact pruning for table-level conflicts
(single-file vs sharded/compressed variants) in TPC generators.

4) Harden DataFrame cache conversion flow: restrict output to schema/source
table set for the benchmark run and prune leaf files not tracked in
_manifest.json after successful writes.

5) Fix Data Vault manifest entry path handling so recorded paths are valid and
relative/portable under output_dir.

6) Add one-time migration utility to move existing DB artifacts out of datagen
and optionally prune untracked stale files in dry-run/apply modes.
description:
benchmark_runs/datagen has drifted due to mixed responsibilities (SQL datagen,
DataFrame cache, and database-engine artifacts) plus missing normalization and
insufficient cleanup paths.

This item implements a comprehensive fix that:
  - normalizes benchmark IDs in BaseBenchmark naming paths
  - moves SQL/DataFusion database artifacts to benchmark_runs/databases
  - prevents stale-file coexistence during regeneration
  - keeps DataFrame cache manifests and leaf directories in sync
  - prevents cross-benchmark cache contamination (including OBT leakage)
  - fixes malformed Data Vault manifest paths

Scope includes code changes, tests, and a one-time migration utility for
existing polluted workspaces.

anti_patterns.dont: collapse SQL datagen and DataFrame cache manifest formats into one schema
anti_patterns.instead: preserve both and enforce local consistency

anti_patterns.dont: delete all sidecar/tool files unconditionally after generation
anti_patterns.instead: prune only conflicts or explicit maintenance targets
anti_patterns.why: some flows may depend on them for reuse/debug

anti_patterns.dont: perform broad recursive deletion based only on extension patterns
rename existing database filenames or tuning suffixes

preserves.behavior: Current dual-manifest model remains intact: _datagen_manifest.json for SQL data and _manifest.json for DataFrame cache
Existing benchmark run semantics for data generation and loading remain functional across supported platforms
Existing database filename conventions (including tuning suffixes) remain unchanged

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/dataframe/test_data_loader.py tests/unit/platforms/test_duckdb.py tests/unit/platforms/test_datafusion.py tests/unit/core/tpcds -v --tb=short
verifications.description: Updated modules pass targeted unit coverage
Dry-run migration reports expected DB moves and stale candidates without writing
verifications.expected: summary includes candidate database moves from datagen to databases
